decisions.briefing: NASDAQ jumped +2.1% and S&P 500 +1.4% today, a clear risk-on session. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we deployed into LUNR, FIVN, and FLY — all top-scored (95) with full multi-signal confirmation (RSI in bullish range, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20).

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based buying pushed the NASDAQ up 2.1% and the S&P 500 up 1.4%, with momentum concentrated in smaller-cap growth names showing strong technical setups. No specific news catalyst was provided in today's data feed, so the move appears driven by broad market sentiment and sector rotation into risk assets. Volume and breadth across the screened candidates suggest institutional participation rather than a narrow rally.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤全面走高,納斯達克指數上升2.1%,標普500指數上升1.4%,升幅主要集中於具強勁技術訊號的中小型成長股。今日數據未提供具體新聞觸發因素,顯示今次上升較大機率源於整體市場情緒轉向風險資產及板塊輪動。從篩選出的候選股表現睇,升勢似乎有機構資金參與支持,而非個別股份帶動嘅狹幅升市。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-on' day is when investors broadly move money into higher-risk, higher-reward assets like growth stocks, signaled here by NASDAQ rising over 2%. On these days, strategy calls for deploying idle cash into your strongest, multi-signal-confirmed candidates rather than sitting on the sidelines.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好上升」(Risk-On)指投資者傾向將資金投入高風險高回報資產,例如成長股,今日納指升逾2%正是訊號。喺呢類日子,策略建議將閒置現金投放於訊號最強、經多重指標確認嘅候選股,而唔係持續持現金觀望。
